metadata.title: IPC → BNS / CrPC → BNSS / Indian Evidence Act → BSA Cross-Reference Dataset
metadata.description: Starter dataset for the IPC↔BNS Cross-Reference Engine feature. Structured to match the build spec: forward lookup, reverse lookup, change-type tagging, commencement tracking, and a case-law log.
sources_consulted: Bureau of Police Research & Development (BPRD) — official 'Comparison Summary BNS to IPC' (bprd.nic.in)
Ministry of Home Affairs / India Code — bare Act texts of BNS, BNSS, BSA
PRS India legislative briefs on the Bharatiya Nyaya (Second) Sanhita, 2023
Secondary legal-practice comparison guides (iPleaders, LawSikho) used only to shortlist commonly-cited sections for this starter set
metadata.disclaimer: This file is a STARTER dataset covering the most frequently cited sections, not the full 500+ section mapping the spec calls for. Per the source document's own Completion Checklist, every row must be cross-checked against the bare Act and signed off by at least two verified advocates before this is used as a production reference or shown to end users. Do not treat 'change_type' or 'what_changed' fields as authoritative until that review pass is complete. Field 'verified: false' is set on every row for this reason.

commencement_status.notes: BNS, BNSS and BSA came into force simultaneously on 1 July 2024 across India. This starter dataset does not yet track any state-specific delayed-notification provisions — the build spec calls for this to be sourced from official gazette notifications and kept current on an ongoing basis.

which_code_applies_rule.rule: Substantive offences committed BEFORE 2024-07-01 are charged and tried under IPC / Indian Evidence Act. Substantive offences committed ON OR AFTER 2024-07-01 are charged under BNS / BSA. Procedural matters (bail, remand, FIR, summons, inherent powers, etc.) for ALL cases — including those where the underlying offence pre-dates the transition — are governed by BNSS, not the old CrPC.
